items.headline: KFC unveils 'Open House' prototype as centerpiece of its U.S. comeback plan
items.summary: KFC opened its Open House prototype in McKinney, Texas, as a test bed for new service formats and dining room upgrades.
items.signal: New formats mean new to-go and dine-in packaging specs. Franchisees rebuilding stores often re-shop consumables.
items.nextStep: Mostly a national contract. Watch for KFC franchisee groups that announce remodels in your region.

items.dateNote: Date unconfirmed. Deal still pending approval.
items.headline: Restaurants are worried about the Sysco–Restaurant Depot deal
items.summary: Independent operators fear higher prices and fewer options if Sysco's $29.1B purchase of Restaurant Depot goes through. Median pretax margin for independents is down to 2.8%.
items.signal: Independents are nervous about losing their cash-and-carry backup. They'll listen to a second source on disposables.
items.nextStep: Use it as an opener with independent and small multi-unit operators.
items.opener:
Hi [Name],
A lot of independents I talk to are worried about what the Sysco and Restaurant Depot deal does to their prices. I'd like to be your backup on gloves, liners and to-go so you're not stuck with one option. Can you and I discuss?
Tony

items.headline: McDonald's plans $8.5B in franchisee support for remodels and growth
items.summary: At its investor day, McDonald's laid out its 'Next' strategy: remodels, training, tech and chicken growth, backed by $8.5B in franchisee support.
items.signal: Franchisees are about to spend on remodels. Consumables are mostly locked in through the system, so this is background.
items.nextStep: Watch only. National supply contracts cover most of this.

items.headline: Index partially recognizes the third containerboard price hike of 2026
items.summary: Fastmarkets RISI recognized part of the latest producer increase. It's the third containerboard hike this year.
items.signal: Box and shipper costs keep climbing. Buyers will be seeing it on their next invoice.
items.nextStep: Call box and shipper buyers. Offer to check what they're paying against the market.
items.opener:
Hi [Name],
Containerboard just took its third price hike this year, and it's going to show up on box invoices. I can run a quick check on what you're paying for boxes and shippers. Can you and I discuss?
Tony

items.headline: Aldi to roll out its first ready-made meals line
items.summary: Seven fresh meals: five microwavable single-serves under $8 and two oven-ready family sizes under $15. Rollout starts in October and goes nationwide by January 2027.
items.signal: Whoever co-packs these is scaling fast and needs sealed meal trays, lidding film and sealers now.
items.nextStep: Find the co-packer from the 'distributed by' line on the label once the meals hit shelves in October.
items.opener:
Hi [Name],
I saw you're producing the new Aldi ready meals. Congrats. When a line ramps that fast, tray and film supply is usually where it gets tight. I supply meal trays, lidding film and sealers and can get you a side-by-side quick. Can you and I discuss?
Tony

items.headline: Starbird signs 17-unit deal in Washington with Mehta Investment Group
items.summary: The fast-casual chicken brand is entering Washington through a 17-restaurant development deal with franchisee Mehta Investment Group.
items.signal: A franchise group opening 17 stores needs gloves, liners and to-go supply from day one.
items.nextStep: Find the ops or purchasing lead at Mehta Investment Group. Ask what's brand-mandated and what's open.
items.opener:
Hi [Name],
Congrats on the Starbird deal. 17 stores is a big build. Most brands leave some room on gloves, liners and back-of-house items, and that's where I can save you real money. Can you and I discuss?
Tony

items.headline: Sabert sells to private equity firm Butterfly Equity
items.summary: Butterfly Equity is buying Sabert, maker of hinged to-go containers, salad bowls, oven-safe meal trays and platters. The deal is expected to close in Q4.
items.signal: New PE owners often trim SKUs and push price. Buyers running on Sabert may want a second source.
items.nextStep: Pitch a second-source quote to accounts running Sabert containers and trays.
items.opener:
Hi [Name],
With Sabert being sold to a private equity firm, a lot of buyers are wondering what happens to pricing and SKUs. I can quote you a backup on your to-go containers and trays so you're covered either way. Can you and I discuss?
Tony

items.headline: Plastics get pulled into tariff turmoil
items.summary: Plastic bags, lids and caps face tariff rates as high as 50%, adding cost pressure across plastic packaging.
items.signal: Can liners, lids and plastic to-go items are about to cost more. It's a good reason to call.
items.nextStep: Call liner and lid buyers. Offer a price check before their next order.
items.opener:
Hi [Name],
The new tariffs on plastic bags and lids are going to hit liner and lid prices. Before your next order, let me price check what you're paying. Can you and I discuss?
Tony

items.headline: Smurfit Westrock and Pratt seek duties on imported pizza boxes
items.summary: The two U.S. producers petitioned for anti-dumping duties on corrugated pizza boxes from China, Malaysia and Turkey.
items.signal: If duties land, imported pizza box prices go up. Pizzerias buying imports should lock in a plan now.
items.nextStep: Reach pizza chains and independents on imported boxes. Offer a domestic and import comparison.
items.opener:
Hi [Name],
There's a trade case that could put duties on imported pizza boxes. If you're buying imports, now's a good time to look at a backup. I can put numbers side by side for you. Can you and I discuss?
Tony

items.headline: Fastmarkets RISI plans to add a corrugated box cost index
items.summary: A proposed monthly box cost index could change how corrugated pricing gets set and passed through to buyers.
items.signal: Background for box pricing talks. Watch how buyers react once contracts start tying to it.
items.nextStep: Watch only. Useful context for box contract talks.

items.headline: New franchisee signings push HB Protein Smoothies' pipeline past 250 locations
items.summary: New deals include 6+ units in South Florida for 7 Brew owner Bob Morris (first opening within 90 days), 5–10 in Fort Myers, and 12+ across Arizona, Idaho and Oregon for the Smooth Papas group, with Phoenix possibly opening in November. The brand has only 3 stores open today.
items.signal: Smoothie shops burn through cups, straws, lids and gloves. Operators opening their first units in the next 90 days haven't locked in suppliers yet.
items.nextStep: Reach Bob Morris (South Florida) and Chris Phillips of Smooth Papas (Phoenix) before their first openings. Ask what the brand mandates and what's open.
items.opener:
Hi [Name],
Congrats on signing with HB Protein Smoothies. With your first store coming up soon, I'd like to help on cups, straws, lids and gloves before you lock in a supplier. Can you and I discuss?
Tony

items.headline: Amy's Kitchen closing its Santa Rosa, Calif., plant
items.summary: Amy's is closing Santa Rosa and cutting about 260 roles. Pizza, soup and burrito work moves to Medford, Ore., and entree production moves to Pocatello, Idaho.
items.signal: Pocatello and Medford are picking up volume, and moving lines is when plants re-spec trays, film and packaging supplies.
items.nextStep: Call the purchasing or packaging manager at Amy's Pocatello, Idaho plant about entree trays, film and gloves as volume moves in.
items.opener:
Hi [Name],
I saw Amy's is moving entree production to Pocatello. When volume shifts that fast, trays, film and gloves are usually where supply gets tight. I'd like to be a backup source for you. Can you and I discuss?
Tony

items.headline: Tandem Foods invests $42 million in bar production plant
items.summary: Tandem Foods is adding 79,000 sq ft in O'Hara Township, near Pittsburgh, for a new cold-form bar line. It's expected to add 83 jobs over three years, the largest investment in the company's 40-year history.
items.signal: A new line means new demand for shipper cases and gloves, and the buyer will be setting up vendors for it.
items.nextStep: Reach the purchasing manager at Tandem Foods' Pittsburgh-area plant about cases and gloves for the new line.
items.opener:
Hi [Name],
Congrats on the new bar line near Pittsburgh. Before it ramps, I'd like to quote your shipper cases and gloves. Can you and I discuss?
Tony

items.headline: Senators Hassan and Tuberville reintroduce bill to ban PFAS in food packaging
items.summary: The bipartisan Keep Food Containers Safe from PFAS Act would ban PFAS in food wrappers and packaging nationwide. Several states already have their own bans.
items.signal: It's still a pending bill, but it gives operators a reason to check if their fiber to-go items are PFAS-free.
items.nextStep: Watch only. Use it as a talking point with buyers of molded fiber and paper to-go items.

items.headline: NAW appeals ruling that upheld Oregon's EPR packaging law
items.summary: The National Association of Wholesaler-Distributors filed an appeal with the Ninth Circuit after a judge upheld Oregon's extended producer responsibility law. NAW has similar challenges pending in California and Colorado.
items.signal: EPR fees could push distributor prices up in Oregon, California and Colorado. It's background for pricing talks there.
items.nextStep: Watch only. Bring it up with West Coast accounts when discussing pricing.
